item.title: China executes 11 members of Myanmar-based syndicate in crackdown on scam operations
item.description: BANGKOK (AP) — China executed 11 members of a Myanmar-based family crime syndicate that killed 14 Chinese citizens and ran scam and gambling operations worth more than $1 billion, authorities said.
